finalText:
I worked all nine open flight-change requests from yesterday. Each customer is on the flight they asked for, in the cabin they booked, and every request is resolved with a note explaining the charges.

One correction to the plan: the system's date is 2026-07-28, not 2026-10-06, so "yesterday" was 2026-07-27. All nine requests are from that date. I left Q-306 alone because it's a cancellation, not a flight change.

No airline cancellations were involved, so the normal fare rules applied unless a bulletin in effect today covered the change. No money went back to anyone, so I didn't need to check payment cards. Each fee was posted as its own ledger entry (L1–L10):

| Request | Change | Charged | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q-301 R5201 | AA210 → DL542 on 08-06, economy | $0 | The Chicago weather waiver (PB-2026-14) covers it, so the fee and fare difference are waived. |
| Q-302 R5202 | AA660 → AA664 on 08-07, economy | $75 change fee + $35 fare difference | The weather waiver only covers Chicago, and this is a Boston trip. |
| Q-303 R5203 | AA662 → AA664 on 08-07, basic economy | $150 change fee + $25 fare difference | The waiver the customer cited (PB-2026-09) ended on 07-15 and only covered travel through 07-20. The $150 basic economy fee comes from PB-2026-16, and silver members aren't exempt. |
| Q-304 R5204 | UA88 → UA90 on 08-09, basic economy | $35 fare difference | The waiver drops the change fee, but on basic economy it still collects the fare difference. |
| Q-305 R5205 | AA214 → AA216 on 08-08, economy | $75 change fee + $10 fare difference | Booked on 07-26, after the waiver's 07-24 cutoff. |
| Q-307 R5207 | AA212 → AA218 on 08-08, economy | $0 | PB-2026-14A extends the waiver to 08-05 travel for gold and platinum members, and he's platinum. He offered to pay, but nothing was owed. |
| Q-308 R5208 | AA660 → AA662, same day (08-05), economy | $75 change fee | Same-day change bulletin (PB-2026-12): a flat fee and no fare difference. |
| Q-309 R5209 | Second flight only: AA1402 → AA1406 on 08-03, economy | $0 | The trip passes through Chicago on 08-03, so the weather waiver applies, and that's cheaper than the same-day fee (PB-2026-17). His first flight stays the same, and he has 7.5 hours to connect. |
| Q-310 R5210 | AA210 → AA216 on 08-08, economy | $75 change fee + $30 fare difference | He already used his one free waiver move on 07-26. |

Two judgement calls you may want to check:
- **Charging customers who expected a free change:** in Q-302, Q-303, Q-305 and Q-310 the customer expected no charge. Because the task was to make each change, I went ahead, charged under the normal rules and explained why in each note. None of them had said they'd pay.
- **Q-309:** I treated a trip that only connects through Chicago as "travel to or from ORD" under the waiver. If that reading is too broad, the same-day fee of $75 would apply instead.
